posts.cooked:
Hello All,

I have a question regarding valuation rate - when I create a landed cost voucher, the valuation rate for that item changes. And if the item already exists in that warehouse, the existing item valuation rate will not change, only newly entered ones.

Is there a way to change the valuation rate across all warehouse for that item (old stock as well) once a landed cost voucher is created?

posts.name: Ahsan Tareen
posts.cooked:
Hi @Ayesha

The Valuation mechanism works for all items Warehouse Wise and Landed Cost Voucher can be applied only for either Purchase Receipt or Purchase Invoice items. The same item may be located in any other warehouse within the company does not cover for landed cost impact.

You can run Stock Entry or Stock Recon to upate same item in different warehouse with promoted valuation rate as well.
